name: Cognitive Memory Hub — Working, Episodic, Semantic, Procedural & Retention
purpose: Full cognitive memory lifecycle: working memory buffering, multi-tier episodic memory recording, vector-based semantic retrieval, procedural/skill memory encoding, consolidation, traceability, retention enforcement, and multi-user isolation.
registration: DynamicMemoryHub::register_user allocates isolated user partition; MemoryEngine::init loads existing episode index; StorageRetentionManager::init loads quota configuration dynamically.
discovery: MemoryEngine::query_semantic_episodes performs cosine vector search; get_recent_episodes retrieves recency window.
execution: MemoryEngine::record_episode stores turn interactions with traceability fields; MemoryEngine::consolidate_episodes compresses older episodes; StorageRetentionManager::enforce_retention expires stale episodes within quota.
memory_link: Core provider of contextual memory for TaraBrain turn processing.
learning_link: Consolidated memory episodes are distilled into training candidates by AutonomousOnlineLearner.
self_evolution_link: High-utility memory patterns are prioritized for persistent fast-weights and knowledge graph integration.
world_model_link: Memory ≠ World Model. Episodic memory stores WHAT happened; WorldStateTracker stores CURRENT entity states. Both are distinct and explicitly related — memory feeds world model inference but they are not the same.
curriculum_link: Curriculum order mirrors memory tiering from primary factual retention to phd conceptual synthesis.
safety_gates: Multi-user tenant isolation: user A cannot read user B episodes
Zero plaintext secret leakage: credential redaction prior to disk write
StorageRetentionManager enforces quota bounds — no unbounded disk growth
Sensitive fields (passphrase, token, secret_key, id_token) are [REDACTED] before storage

lifecycle.1_working: Working memory buffer holds current-turn context (WorkingMemoryGovernor)
lifecycle.2_retrieve: Vector retrieval finds top-k relevant past episodes for episodic recall
lifecycle.3_integrate: Contextual episodes injected into neural prompt context window
lifecycle.4_record_episodic: Post-turn: record_episode saves EpisodeRecord with source, timestamp, confidence, provenance, task_context, tenant_user, verification_status
lifecycle.5_index: Exact FNV-1a hash and semantic embedding inserted into memory_index
lifecycle.6_procedural: Successful skill/tool patterns encoded into procedural memory via CapabilitySynthesizer
lifecycle.7_consolidate_semantic: Background cycle consolidates short-term episodes into long-term semantic schemas
lifecycle.8_distill: High-value experiences exported as experiential training lessons
lifecycle.9_retain: StorageRetentionManager::enforce_retention — expire stale low-confidence episodes within dynamic quota
